This gives a year-over-year growth rate of approximately 11.83% for FY2023 (2022→2023) and approximately 10.99% for FY2024 (2023→2024).

ANSWER: Decelerated slightly — YoY revenue growth slowed from ~11.8% in FY2023 to ~11.0% in FY2024.
